articles.zh: 直觉：a hunch 是什么意思
body: A "hunch" is a feeling that something is true even when you cannot explain why.
hunch 指一种感觉：你觉得某事是真的，却说不出理由。
We often say we have a hunch before making a guess or a choice based on instinct.
我们常在凭直觉猜测或做决定前说「我有个 hunch」。
In everyday talk it is close to "a gut feeling" and is useful when the facts are not yet clear.
在日常对话里它接近 gut feeling（直觉），在事实还没明朗时很好用。

articles.zh: 想当然：take it as a given 怎么用
body: To "take something as a given" means to accept it as true without questioning it.
take it as a given 意思是不加怀疑地认为某事为真。
People use it when a fact seems so normal that nobody stops to check it.
当某件事看起来太理所当然、没人去验证时，就会这么用。
It is handy for describing the quiet assumptions we make at work or in daily life.
它很适合描述我们在工作或生活里默默做的那些假设。

articles.zh: 临场反应：think on your feet
body: "Think on your feet" means to react quickly and make decisions without preparation.
think on your feet 指不经准备就快速反应、做决定。
It is often used for people who stay calm and clever when plans suddenly change.
常用来形容在计划突变时依然冷静、机灵的人。
Live streamers and teachers need this skill most when the plan goes wrong.
主播和老师计划出岔子时，最需要具备这种能力。
tips: 临场反应 / 随机应变

articles.zh: 英语里带 end 的短语
body: English has many short phrases built around the word "end".
英语里有很多围绕 end 这个词构成的短语。
"At the end of the day" means finally, after everything is considered.
at the end of the day 意思是「说到底、归根结底」。
"No end" means a lot, and "end of story" means the matter is finished and not open for debate.
no end 表示「非常多」，end of story 表示「就这么定了、没得商量」。
tips: at the end of the day

articles.zh: 英语里带 water 的短语
body: The word "water" appears in many common English expressions we use every day.
water 这个词出现在很多我们每天都会用到的英语表达里。
"Water under the bridge" describes past problems we no longer worry about.
water under the bridge 指已经过去、不再纠结的问题。
"Test the water" means to try something carefully before taking a bigger step.
test the water 意思是在迈大步前先小范围试试水。
tips: 过去的事 / 已成定局
站得住脚 / 经得起推敲
